experiment: Activity 4: sample-size effect on an artificial timing side channel
hypothesis: With the same shift-5% channel and analysis, the larger sample will give stronger statistical evidence for a timing difference.
null_hypothesis: Baseline and modified timing distributions are equal.
alternative_hypothesis: Baseline and modified timing distributions differ.
sample_size_means: number of timing observations in each class
analysis: two-sided Mann–Whitney U, tie-corrected normal approximation with continuity correction
